openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything besides the wait and the ride (fare, cooldown, Trail, Alert exposure at watched stations)?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 says time only; the timetable prices only wait + ride, so any other cost is undecided here.

openQuestions.question: Are there limits on who may ride (e.g. wanted persons, armed cells, injured members)?
openQuestions.why: The GDD says board at any stop, with no restriction stated; none is assumed in the timetable.

openQuestions.question: Is the interchange walk pace (1.4 m/s, [S]) acceptable, and does the cell wait for the next service after changing line?
openQuestions.why: The GDD states no walking pace; wait at each change is not included in journey totals.

notes: T1 speed 8 m/s: tram stops are 300-500 m apart (standards), giving ~39 s runs; slow enough to read as street running on a double track with 25-50 m radii.
T1 dwell 15 s, headway 120 s [S]: a short wait on a three-stop line; average wait ~60 s keeps boarding cheap but a real cost.
S1 speed 12 m/s: elevated, 24 m high, stations 200-500 m apart, so ~17-21 s runs; faster than the tram so the sky rail is the quick option.
S1 dwell 12 s, headway 90 s [S]: shorter than the tram, in line with the faster mode; all values are starting values to tune by playtest.
Only one interchange exists, T1/circus <-> S1/circus (about 119 m straight line, within the 150 m standard); every cross-network journey goes through it.
Journeys cover each tram end to each sky rail end in both directions, plus one single-line ride per network. Code derives run times and totals; none are stated here.
Not decided and not invented: fares, cooldowns, rider limits (see openQuestions). Scale and loop questions in the plan notes are Datum's; stops are used as they stand.
